task: Finish the already-declared rename of the CLI brand from lattice to proof-or-stop across the forward-looking surfaces (bin name, active docs, CLI output strings) while leaving historical records and signature-bearing identifiers frozen.
outcome: A user can run `proof-or-stop <command>` and every doc, help screen and session-brief header they encounter says proof-or-stop / Proof-or-Stop; `lattice` still works as a deprecated alias; root `npm test` stays green; and README.md no longer needs its rename-in-progress disclaimer because the rename is done.
facts: README.md:96 already declares the intended end state verbatim: 'lattice is the CLI command name for historical reasons; the project is Proof-or-Stop. (lattice --version currently prints Proofbound CLI - a rename in progress.)' This story completes that declared rename rather than inventing a new direction.
README.md:1 titles the product 'Proof-or-Stop', establishing the canonical prose form; LATTICE_PRODUCT_NAME in packages/main/src/core/lattice-brand.ts:4 is currently the legacy 'Proofbound CLI'.

packages/main/package.json exposes exactly one bin: {"lattice": "dist/cli.js"}. bin/lattice.js is a 3-line wrapper that calls runLocalBootstrap() from bootstrap-runner.js, so adding a second bin name is cheap and additive.
detectLatticeBrand() in lattice-brand.ts:15 ALREADY computes invokedAs from basename(argv[1]), so the alias-aware plumbing is half-built.

invokedAs is computed but never consumed anywhere: all 11 help-output sites in packages/main/src/cli/help-renderer.ts interpolate brand.primaryBin instead, so `proof-or-stop help` would print 'Usage: lattice <command>' until the constant is flipped or the call sites switch to invokedAs.

391 brand-bearing markdown files are frozen archives under .lattice/story/, leaving roughly 183 active docs as the real surface. The total drifts upward while this story runs because the story's own artifacts are brand-bearing markdown, so 391 frozen is the stable anchor.

packages/main/templates/agents/ holds 17 role templates, of which exactly 13 carry the lattice- prefix. scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs pins EXPECTED_ROLE_COUNT=17. CLAUDE.md's own '16 thin-shim' claim is stale and must be corrected by this story.

13 signature salt literals (lattice-review-integrity-v1 and siblings) are hashed into _hash fields already persisted on live artifacts; renaming any of them invalidates every stored signature and would gate-block all active stories.

packages/main/src/core/audit-scan.ts:100 extracts documented commands with /\blattice\s+([a-z](?:[a-z0-9_]*[a-z0-9])?)\b/g and shells out to '<cmd> --help', reporting drift on non-zero exit. After a docs rename the regex matches nothing, the loop body never runs, and scanCommandDrift returns zero drifts - a VACUOUS PASS rather than a loud failure.

.githooks/pre-push:148 gates the entire recursive-tsc pre-push defense on PKG_NAME equal to '@lattice/core' and exits 0 when it does not match, so renaming the npm package silently self-disarms that gate instead of failing.

Three brand-pinned test surfaces feed root npm test, which lattice.config.json doneRequiredCommands requires for DONE: scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs (asserts literal prompt strings such as 'lattice acceptance_basis_generate'), scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs (freezes a per-role templateHash manifest), and scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs:277/:515 (pins the literal '# lattice session brief' header emitted by packages/main/src/handlers/session.ts:777).

packages/main/src/handlers/review-preflight.ts:91 hardcodes 'scripts/verify-lattice-residue.mjs' and fails closed when the file is absent, so renaming that script without updating the handler blocks this story's own REVIEW-to-TEST advance.

scripts/verify-lattice-residue.mjs is a zero-tolerance gate whose detector is /koala/i, enforcing the PREVIOUS koala-to-lattice rebrand, and its inline self-test asserts that 'lattice-review-integrity-v1' is CLEAN - an assertion that now contradicts the new brand direction.
ProofStory is a distinct domain concept, not a brand variant: handlers/proofstory.ts, createProofStoryHandlers and ProofStoryContractData are live code and must be preserved verbatim.
The repo brand state is already mixed: Proofbound 1177, proof-or-stop 439, ProofStory 267, plus stray one-off spellings Prooforstop / proof-stop / Proof-Or-Stop / proofstop / PROOFBOUND.

U1 RESOLVED: only ONE test asserts the primary bin name (packages/main/src/tasks/rollout-check-smoke.ts:70 asserts primaryBin equals 'lattice'), so flipping LATTICE_PRIMARY_BIN is a one-test change. Separately packages/main/src/cli/alias-normalizer.ts:94 hardcodes argv[0] === 'lattice' for the redundant-token tolerance, so it must learn the new token too or 'proof-or-stop proof-or-stop validate' errors while the lattice equivalent is forgiven.

U2 RESOLVED: the residue script FILENAME has at least 6 live couplings - package.json:19 (test:lattice-residue), packages/main/src/handlers/review-preflight.ts:91 (fails closed if absent), CLAUDE.md:835 (gate table), scripts/verify-residue-inject-repro.mjs:31 (asserts the gate path), plus experiment fixtures under experiments/ and decision docs. Therefore KEEP the filename verify-lattice-residue.mjs and change only its detector plus self-test; renaming the file is strictly higher risk for zero user benefit.

U3 RESOLVED: CLAUDE.md's stale shim count appears at exactly two sites, CLAUDE.md:791 and CLAUDE.md:792 (both say 16). Both are inside CHK-003's existing prose surface, so correcting them to 13-of-17 belongs in CHK-003 rather than a separate story.

The residue gate currently PASSES ('PASS lattice-residue: 0 brand residue in product runtime source'), and 605 files inside its scan scope (packages/main/src, packages/lab/src, packages/utils/src) contain the lattice token. A naive /lattice/i zero-tolerance detector would therefore flag 605 files, mechanically proving the new brand gate CANNOT reuse the koala gate's allowlist-free design and must be scoped to prose or to an explicit exemption model.
constraints: User decision 2026-08-11, governing rule: the rename affects current state and future work, not past work or history. Operationally - if a surface records what already happened it is FROZEN; if it tells a user what to run now or next it is RENAMED.
FROZEN, breaks stored signatures: the 13 signature salt literals.
FROZEN, past record: the 391 story archives under .lattice/story/ (CLAUDE.md rule 8 forbids direct writes) and CHANGELOG.md (shipped release notes).
FROZEN, breaks stored state: the .lattice/ state directory plus .lattice-serve.json and .lattice-codex/.
FROZEN, breaks resolution: the 13 lattice-prefixed agent role IDs used as subagent_type values.
FROZEN, self-disarms a safety gate: the npm package names 'lattice' and '@lattice/core'.
FROZEN, external contract: lattice.config.json, the LATTICE_* env-var prefix, the '<!-- lattice:start -->' managed-block markers, and the 'lattice.remote-push-approval.v1' schema literal.
The lattice alias must keep working; removing it is explicitly out of scope so in-flight stories and hooks do not break mid-flight.
Docs must never instruct a command or path that does not actually resolve - no doc may claim proof-or-stop before the bin exists.
Root npm test must stay green, since lattice.config.json doneRequiredCommands consumes it for DONE.
After the rename, docs-drift must still fail LOUDLY on a bogus command rather than passing vacuously.
CLI patch version must bump 0.3.251 to 0.3.252 per CLAUDE.md version discipline, because CHK-002 changes runtime behavior.
Story artifacts must be authored in English (the english-artifacts preflight rejects CJK in story metadata and branch commits).
